steps.note: S1.3.1.1 tracks the scratch vectors a,c through rows 0-7 and concludes the target changes by (JV+RG)x whatever a,c are, quoting line 748.
S1.3.1.2 gives the bit-case central coefficient |S cap T| mod 2, the side wires cancelling exactly the intersection-one cases, and self coefficient one.
S1.3.1.3 gives the complex central coefficient (|S cap T|-1)/2 with the side cancelling intersections zero and two, intersection one contributing zero, and self coefficient one.
S1.3.1.4 states the three stages (x,y)->(x,y+x)->(-y,y+x)->(-y,x) using the inverse schedule X<-X-Y, with each invocation restoring its auxiliary wires.
The plan asserts that every edge joins nested (comparable) labels (S1.3.3, S1.3.3.4) but never gives the per-edge orthogonal residuals or their dimensions from the residual table.

S1.3.3.3 states the inclusion <t_X> in t_Y^perp from t_X perp t_Y (quoting the label construction at line 953), but not the side edge 2->5 residual <t_X,t_Y>^perp or its dimension h-2, so only half the sub-step is given.

The plan states that center 3->4 is the only decreasing edge, losing h=100; that source dimensions sum to N and sink dimensions to Wm-N; and that telescoping at gates gives Wm-2N, with absolute changes adding 2L.

S1.3.3.6 states that over F_2 every nonzero residual contains a norm-one vector, is nondegenerate and nonalternating, and so has an orthonormal basis; the plane-absorption argument (a 'for completeness' remark in the paper) is not spelled out.
S1.3.3.7 gives L_b/N=100/539 and L_c/N=101/539 exactly.
S1.3.5.1 gives the weight identity, additivity mod 4 when z.w=0, and q_V-q_U as a sum of wt(v)[v.x] over an orthonormal basis of the residual.
S1.3.5.2 states that each basis vector has odd weight, so the phase is i^{+-[v.x]} with the displayed two-term expansion, and that H diag(1,-1) H = X turns it into aI+bX_v or its inverse.

The plan counts s_c kernels (S1.3.5, S1.3.5.3) and s_c children on slots (S1.5.1), but it never states that on k columns the tensor power of the frame change factors into one tensored kernel per residual vector.

S1.5.1.5 names the source and sink Z signs, the scalar i^{27f} and the negation of the X bank, but not the zero and full label frames I and C^{tensor m}, the C^{-1} on the 27 coordinates of supp(u_a), or the identity C=iZC^{-1}Z that these corrections repair.
The plan states that both loss ratios are below 1/2, so the deficits N-2L_b>0 and 2N-2L_c>0 hold and s<Wm for both networks.
S1.3.6 states that both deficits exceed 20*2^{-50} and log m<20, so m^{1-2^{-50}}>m(1-20*2^{-50}) gives s/W<m^tau with tau=sigma=1-2^{-50}, quoting line 1331.
S1.3.7.1 gives elimination from the topmost nonzero row with its rightmost pivot, using only lower-triangular operations and isolating one rank-one block per step, so Pi has exactly a ones.

S1.3.7 mentions only a hypothesis '(q a fixed odd prime avoiding all denominators)'; it gives neither the finite table of factors nor that the rational identities specialize to Z/q^b with the triangular factors still invertible.
S1.3.7.2 states that a lower-triangular transformation costs O(V) by updating coordinates in descending physical order from earlier, still unchanged coordinates.
S1.3.7.3 gives D_j<-D_j+H_i, one interchange, D_j<-H_i-D_j for each one of Pi, so exactly a interchanges in all.

The plan gives E=64(W+m+1)^3, B=s+E, m^{10}<B<m^{11}, Delta=ceil(C_0 d^{20}) and C_1=20 (S3.5.1), but it never defines C_0=128mB^2, nu, or the rule C_1=max{20,nu+3}, so the constant set is incomplete.
S1.5.4's method gives A(e)<=sA(e/m)+E, and S1.5.4.1 states that each invocation adds at most E operations and that leaves need at most 8e.
S1.5.4.1 gives the resulting depth bound 8B^2 d^{12} but not the unrolling step B^{k+1}<=B^2 d^nu, nor the summation over pieces, kernels and phases that keeps the total below C_0 d^{C_1}.
S1.5.4.2 states that values at depth l lie in 2^{-(p+l)}Z[i] with modulus at most 2^l, so p+Delta fractional and Delta+3 integer bits suffice; S1.5.4.3 states that 20 epsilon<1 gives Delta=o(p).
S1.5.5 states that every row of H has absolute row sum one, so disks are preserved and the single truncation errs by less than sqrt2 2^{-p}, quoting line 2752.

summary: P09 covers the bank exchange (4/4), rank saving (4/4) and most of the label budget (3/5), complex phase interface (2/4), matrix shear (3/4) and simultaneous layer (3/5): 19 of 26 present, none wrong. It omits the residual table and the h-2 side-edge residual, the k-column tensoring and the endpoint 27-coordinate C^{-1} repair, the prime's specialization argument, and the full constant set and depth unrolling to C_0 d^{C_1}.
